```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| results: asis
csv_name <- "chartbook_F4.csv"
csv_tmp  <- file.path(tempdir(), csv_name)
download.file(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GPID-WB/pip-chartbook/refs/heads/main/csv/chartbook_F4.csv",
  destfile = csv_tmp,
  mode = "wb",
  quiet = TRUE
)
# Plain <a download> holding the CSV as a data: URI.
# downloadthis::download_file() is deliberately NOT used here: the handler it
# generates calls fetch() on the data: URI, and PositConnect serves a
# Content-Security-Policy whose connect-src has no data:, so the fetch was
# blocked and the button failed with "Download failed. Please try again."
# An anchor download is not governed by any CSP directive.
cat(sprintf(
  '<div class="cell-output-display"><a class="btn btn-primary" href="data:text/csv;base64,%s" download="%s"><i class="bi bi-download"></i> Download data as csv</a></div>',
  xfun::base64_encode(csv_tmp), csv_name
))
```

<p style="font-size: 0.5em; color: #555; margin-top: 0.5em;">

Note: Poverty rates are reported for the \$3.00 per person per day poverty line (expressed in 2021 PPP dollars). Poverty is projected after 2024 based on per capita GDP growth projections in the June 2026 Global Economic Prospects complemented by the April 2026 Macro Poverty Outlook and the World Economic Outlook. Projections after 2030 are based on average annual historical per capita GDP growth rates from 2024-2025. The black horizontal line indicates the World Bank Group’s target for 3% extreme poverty by 2030.

</p>
